item.title: Child with head injury found alone in West Garfield Park
item.description: <p>An 11-year-old boy with a head injury was found alone on a street Friday night in the West Garfield Park neighborhood.</p><p>Police were called for a well-being check at 7:30 p.m. in the 200 block of South Kostner where they found him, according to a statement from Chicago police. The boy was taken to Stroger Hospital in serious condition. </p><p>He was placed in protective police custody as detectives investigated. </p>

item.title: Angel Reese embraces role within USA Basketball’s ‘Young and Turnt Crew’
item.description: <p>MIAMI — When Sky star Angel Reese was a kid, she remembers watching FIBA World Cup games with her grandmother, who somehow found a way to get them on TV. That was her introduction to USA Basketball.</p><p>Reese still isn’t sure how her grandma tracked those games down, but the days of hunting for random livestreams are over. For the first time, TNT will broadcast the FIBA World Cup qualifying tournament, which starts this week in Puerto Rico, as well as the World Cup in September in Berlin.</
